_note: Hollowmoon, level 12: always night. See docs/zones.md.

hollowmoon.name: Hollowmoon
hollowmoon.description: A realm of endless night under a moon far too big.

hm_landing.name: The Mirror Pool
hm_landing.description: A still pool that shows a cavern roof instead of the sky. Lanterns all round it.

features.pool: Through it, the Underdeep's Black Lake.

hm_square.name: Lantern Square
hm_square.description: A square hung with a thousand lanterns. The shadows outside them move.

hm_inn.name: The Wick & Moth
hm_inn.description: An inn so bright with candles it hurts.

hm_wood.name: The Silverwood
hm_wood.description: Trees with silver bark under the huge moon. A dead lantern hangs from a branch.

features.lantern: A dead lantern on a hook.

hm_glade.name: Moth Glade
hm_glade.description: A glade full of white moths the size of hands. A lamp-post stands dark.

features.post: A lamp-post, its glass cracked, its wick dry.

hm_path.name: The Shadowed Path
hm_path.description: A path where the moonlight doesn't reach. Something follows you along it.

hm_well.name: The Moonwell
hm_well.description: A well full of moonlight instead of water. Its lamp has gone out.

hm_den.name: The Eclipse Den
hm_den.description: A den in a hill, black as the space between stars.

hm_moongate.name: The Moon Gate
hm_moongate.description: An arch of white stone. Through it, a sky stuck at sunset and a smell of roses.

features.arch: Through it, a twilight realm of thorns.

moon_oil.name: moon-oil
moon_oil.description: A flask of oil that glows faintly blue.

siel.name: Siel
siel.label: Lantern-keeper
siel.description: a pale young man with a lantern on a pole
siel.details: A pale young man with a lantern on a pole.

topics.work: Ask me about the lanterns, the hunt, or the hound.

lanterns.text: Three lights have gone out: the lantern in the Silverwood, the post in Moth Glade, the lamp at the Moonwell. Every dark one lets the stalkers closer. Take moon-oil.

topics.oil: It burns cold. Don't touch the flame.

hunt.text: The shadow-stalkers hunt anyone outside the lights. Four of them. They watch before they strike: if you see one first, you choose.

hound.text: The Eclipse Hound swallowed the last lantern-keeper. It dens past the Moonwell. Its eclipse can only be dodged.

moonsilver_dirk.name: Moonsilver Dirk
moonsilver_dirk.description: A dirk of moonsilver. Strongest in still, cold night air.

eclipse_fang.name: Eclipse Fang
eclipse_fang.description: A fang of the Eclipse Hound. In the cold it bites like the dark itself.

nightweave_hood.name: Nightweave Hood
nightweave_hood.description: A hood woven from shadow. +2 Poise.

black-mirror.name: the Black Mirror
black-mirror.depart: You step onto the still water, and fall up into moonlight.
black-mirror.arrive: {actor} climbs out of the Mirror Pool, dry.

mirror-pool.name: the Mirror Pool
mirror-pool.depart: You step into the pool, and fall down into the dark.
mirror-pool.arrive: {actor} rises out of the Black Lake.

moon-gate.name: the Moon Gate
moon-gate.depart: You walk through the arch, and the sun is setting.
moon-gate.arrive: {actor} steps out of a moonlit arch.

effects.text: The well blazes. The shadows draw back.
